cards.ex: My sister's always been the brainy one in the family; she's a doctor now.
cards.exUz: Singlim doim oilada eng aqlli bo'lgan; hozir u shifokor.
cards.uzDef: Juda aqlli, bilimdon odam. Ko'pincha norasmiy ishlatiladi.

cards.ex: He's a nice guy, but a little slow-witted, if you know what I mean.
cards.exUz: U yaxshi yigit, lekin biroz sekin fahmlaydi, agar nimani nazarda tutayotganimni tushunsangiz.
cards.uzDef: Tez fahmlamaydigan, anglashga qiynaladigan odam.

cards.ex: Whose bright idea was it to go camping in the rain?
cards.exUz: Yomg'irda sayohatga borish kimning ajoyib fikri edi?
cards.uzDef: Ajoyib, foydali, aqlli fikr.

cards.ex: He's so clumsy, he couldn't pour water out of a boot if you gave him the instructions on the heel.
cards.exUz: U juda qo'pol, agar unga ko'rsatma berilsa ham, etikdan suv quyolmaydi.
cards.uzDef: Juda ahmoq, oddiy narsalarni ham uddalay olmaydigan.

cards.ex: Can I pick your brain about this marketing strategy? You're the expert.
cards.exUz: Men sizning marketing strategiyangiz haqida fikringizni so'rasam maylimi? Siz mutaxassis siz.
cards.uzDef: Kimdandir ma'lumot yoki fikr so'rash, maslahat olish.

cards.ex: She's only 10, but she's wise beyond her years; she gives great advice.
cards.exUz: U atigi 10 yoshda, lekin yillaridan dono; u ajoyib maslahatlar beradi.
cards.uzDef: Yoshiga nisbatan juda aqlli va tajribali.

cards.ex: She's a bit scatterbrained, always forgetting where she put her keys.
cards.exUz: U biroz beparvo, doim kalitlarini qayerga qo'yganini unutadi.
cards.uzDef: Diqqatsiz, xotirasi past, tartibsiz odam.

cards.ex: I'm a little slow on the draw this morning; I didn't get much sleep.
cards.exUz: Men bugun ertalab biroz sekin fahmlayapman; men yaxshi uxlamadim.
cards.uzDef: Tez tushunmaydigan, javob berishga qiynaladigan.

cards.ex: She's got a good head on her shoulders; she'll go far in life.
cards.exUz: Uning boshi yaxshi ishlaydi; u hayotda uzoqqa boradi.
cards.uzDef: Aqlli bo'lish, yaxshi fikrlash qobiliyatiga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: Fixing a flat tire isn't rocket science; anyone can do it.
cards.exUz: Shina tuzatish qiyin emas; buni hamma qila oladi.
cards.uzDef: Bu juda oson, tushunish uchun qiyin emas.

cards.ex: He lacks common sense; he tried to dry his phone in the microwave.
cards.exUz: U aqlsiz; u telefonini mikroto'lqinli pechda quritmoqchi bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Oddiy, amaliy fikrlash qobiliyatiga ega emas.

cards.ex: I think he's a few sandwiches short of a picnic, if you know what I mean.
cards.exUz: O'ylashimcha, u biroz aqli zaif, agar nimani nazarda tutayotganimni tushunsangiz.
cards.uzDef: Aqli zaif, biroz ahmoqona odam.

cards.ex: She has a razor-sharp mind; she can solve any problem.
cards.exUz: Uning zehni o'tkir; u har qanday muammoni hal qila oladi.
cards.uzDef: Juda aqlli, tez fikrlaydigan zehn.

cards.ex: He's a nice guy, but he's not the brightest bulb in the box.
cards.exUz: U yaxshi yigit, lekin u qutidagi eng yorqin lampochka emas.
cards.uzDef: Unchalik aqlli emas, biroz ahmoqona.

cards.ex: I had a brainwave last night about how to solve the problem.
cards.exUz: Kecha kechqurun muammoni qanday hal qilish haqida to'satdan fikr keldi.
cards.uzDef: Birdan paydo bo'lgan, yorqin fikr yoki g'oya.

cards.ex: He's as thick as two short planks; I can't believe he doesn't understand.
cards.exUz: U juda ahmoq; Men uning tushunmasligiga ishonmayman.
cards.term: As thick as two short planks
cards.uzDef: Juda ahmoq, tushunish qobiliyati past.

cards.ex: It's important to keep your head in an emergency.
cards.exUz: Favqulodda vaziyatda xotirjam bo'lish muhim.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyat qiyin bo'lganda ham xotirjam bo'lish.

cards.ex: We need to put our thinking caps on and come up with a solution.
cards.exUz: Biz o'ylashga kirishib, yechim topishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Muammoni hal qilish uchun jiddiy o'ylashga kirishish.

cards.ex: That's a half-baked idea; it'll never work.
cards.exUz: Bu xom g'oya; u hech qachon ishlamaydi.
cards.uzDef: Yaxshi o'ylanmagan, to'liq bo'lmagan g'oya.

cards.ex: He's such a dimwit; I can't believe he did that.
cards.exUz: U qanday ahmoq; Men uning buni qilganiga ishonmayman.
cards.uzDef: Ahmoqona, aqlsiz odam (ko'pincha haqorat sifatida ishlatiladi).

cards.ex: He tried to cheat me, but I outsmarted him.
cards.exUz: U meni aldashga harakat qildi, lekin men uni aldab o'tdim.
cards.uzDef: Kimdandir aqlliroq bo'lib, uni aldash yoki mag'lub etish.

cards.ex: I'm a bit of a slow learner, so please be patient with me.
cards.exUz: Men biroz sekin o'rganuvchiman, shuning uchun menga sabr qiling.
cards.uzDef: Yangi narsalarni o'rganishga ko'p vaqt sarflaydigan odam.

cards.ex: In terms of intelligence, he's no match for her.
cards.exUz: Aql jihatidan u unga teng emas.
cards.uzDef: Kimdir bilan solishtirganda unchalik aqlli, kuchli yoki qobiliyatli emas.

cards.ex: That was a completely brainless thing to do!
cards.exUz: Bu mutlaqo aqlsiz ish edi!
cards.uzDef: Juda ahmoq, fikrlash qobiliyati yo'q.

cards.ex: Before you make a decision, get your thinking straight.
cards.exUz: Qaror qabul qilishdan oldin, fikrlaringizni tartibga soling.
cards.uzDef: Fikrlarni aniq va mantiqiy qilish.

cards.ex: Some crackpot theories are circulating online.
cards.exUz: Internetda ba'zi telba nazariyalar tarqalmoqda.
cards.uzDef: G'alati, aqlsiz g'oyalarga ega bo'lgan odam.

cards.ex: Don't play dumb with me; I know you know what happened.
cards.exUz: Menga o'zingni ahmoqqa solma; Men bilaman nima bo'lganini.
cards.uzDef: O'zini ahmoqqa solib, haqiqatni bilmaslikni ko'rsatish.

cards.ex: The company assembled a brain trust to tackle the crisis.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya inqirozni bartaraf etish uchun aqlli guruhni yig'di.
cards.uzDef: Muammolarni hal qilish uchun birlashgan, yuqori aqliy qobiliyatga ega odamlar guruhi.

cards.ex: His intelligence is not to be sneezed at; he's a brilliant scientist.
cards.exUz: Uning aqlini baholamaslik kerak; u ajoyib olim.
cards.uzDef: Arzimas deb hisoblamaslik kerak; ahamiyatga loyiq.

cards.ex: I hope he'll come to his senses and realize he's making a mistake.
cards.exUz: U aqlga kelib, xato qilayotganini tushunishiga umid qilaman.
cards.uzDef: Noto'g'ri fikrlashni to'xtatib, to'g'ri fikrlashga o'tish.
